inputs.text: A reported link to the Karachi-based “Punjabi Kuri” is not proof of guilt, but it is enough to warrant serious scrutiny—not reflexive suspicion of the state. A country’s first duty is to protect its people and preserve public order, while acting lawfully. Liberty matters, but it cannot mean authorities must wait for courtroom-level proof before addressing a potential security risk. Those demanding restraint should also reckon with the consequences of ignoring warning signs.
